verified.exploit_entry_point: Express route handlers that take a caller-supplied credential id, load the stored Credential, decrypt it and use its provider key. The tests import the real route files; the express stub records route registrations and a dispatcher matches method/path, extracts path params and runs the real middleware+controller chain (the RBAC stub answers per permission string). Only the infrastructure boundary is substituted (an in-memory repository with faithful equality/operator matching, credential decryption, the OpenAI SDK, the running-app singleton), in the same style as the project's own unit tests virtual-mocking typeorm and the repository.
variants: base (published fix): the openai-assistants-vector-store module resolves ?credential= by id alone across all 7 routes; the fix scopes it to the caller's active workspace, with an explicit WorkspaceShared share (itemType credential) still resolving
far site (published fix): POST /api/v1/oauth2-credential/authorize/:credentialId puts the credential id in the path and lives in a separate OAuth2 router with inline DB access

uncovered (real upstream): the assistants module (list via GET /openai-assistants, single via GET /openai-assistants/:id) and the third router's POST /openai-assistants-file/upload take ?credential= and do the identical unscoped lookup; this advisory's fix never touches them
injected sibling 1: POST /api/v1/credentials/:id/test validates a credential by decrypting it and calling the provider; path-shaped input, returns only a status
injected sibling 2: POST /api/v1/openai-assistants/thread creates a provider thread with a credential from the request body; returns only an opaque id

how-type sibling (real upstream): the legacy assistants module's delete path reads the credential reference from the stored assistant row (not from the request), resolves it without any workspace scope, decrypts it and hands the key to the provider before deleting; the published fix never touches it. A request-level check on credential fields cannot see this reference; the reference is producible through the module's own create-as-CUSTOM / update-type flow (type and credential are not protected fields). M6 producer the check never calls / M4 route where the protection never existed
verified.project_tests_run: At the pinned commit the project has no unit tests for openai-assistants*, openai-assistants-vector-store, oauth2, the legacy assistants module or the injected helpers (the upstream fix only adds tenantRequestGuards.test.ts, which is not shipped). The hidden jest suites run offline against the product source with the infrastructure stubbed: 19 security tests (all fail on pinned+injected, all pass on the oracle) and 15 functional tests (pass on pinned+injected and on the oracle).
